chatHistory.content: can you make the crossing animation faster? a lot faster

I swapped the two X strokes from spring-based reveals (which had built-in settle time) to raw `interpolate(frame, ...)` with hard clamping. Each stroke now draws in exactly 4 frames (~160ms at 25fps): the first slash from frame 38→42, the second from 42→46. Total crossing is done in 8 frames — about 5× faster than before. Quick whip, no bounce.
